data.one_liner: Onboarding widget for Flutter with customizable slides and navigation
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple widget to display a series of onboarding pages with optional images, text, and navigation controls. It supports custom colors, button text, and background images.
use_when: You need a quick onboarding flow without writing custom page logic
You want to customize button text or colors
You want to animate images or custom widgets on each page
avoid_when: You need complex navigation logic beyond simple next/skip/finish
You require deep integration with state management or navigation frameworks
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single dependency
Supports keyboard and mouse scroll navigation
weaknesses: No built‑in state management or persistence
No support for dynamic content loading
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec, import package, provide list of PageModel, optional callbacks
